comment: Committed expectation for scripts/dev/parity_v08.sh. differs_* list the record ids that are KNOWN to differ (documented gaps, docs/V08_PARITY_SLICE.md); any other difference is a regression. Labels: SUPPORTED / PARTIAL / UNSUPPORTED / UNVERIFIED, each with a one-line evidence pointer. record_ids is the complete, ordered set every transcript must contain exactly once. pinned holds the exact record each allowlisted difference must still be, so a change inside a known gap is a regression too.

resource.comment: gated: peak-RSS growth between rep ceil(N/2) and rep N. At N=500 this flags a per-rep leak of >= ~16 KB; the planted C context leak (PARITY_V08_PERTURB=leak) measured 18304 KB. Rep-1-to-midpoint growth is runtime warm-up (Go GC pacing: ~5.7 MB) and is reported only; Go second-half jitter observed 116 and 512 KB.
